reviews.comment: You need to read the book to really grasp concepts and examples. He is funny and very enthusiastic but does not answer questions well. This class is just poorly run in general.

BMED 2210 is a boring and easy class. Learn it by yourself. Dr. Mantaralis isn't helpful and the TAs were sometimes clueless. However, this is not a stressful class. All materials are straightforward. You don't need to rely on professors and TAs a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: He is a very sweet man who cares a lot about the students, but is not the best teacher. He would emphasize main points over and over instead of working through problems. Only reason I really understood the class was because of the amazing TAs. Still got an A because the TAs graded and they were lenient because they would watch him not teach us.

Attarchi is a gem of a professor. He explains concepts very well and is definitely easier on the grading than other multi professors. He explains the math very well but doesn't visualize it or apply it, so I would recommend watching youtube videos with fancy graphics throughout the semester and that helped me out a lot. Definitely recommend.
Tests are decent difficulty, nothing too hard. Cares about students and willing to make adjustments. Solid choice.

Dr Attarchi is really good at teaching. The only issue I had with him was his accent, but if you listen and pay attention, it's honestly not a big issue. He is one of the most caring professors I have ever had. He made so many adjustments for our benefit during this transition, which shows that if you put in the effort, he'll meet you halfway.

I'll be honest, I rarely paid attention in lecture and never went to office hours, but the few times I did listen to him it really paid off. There is homework due every week but it's honestly not too difficult. The online transition was pretty rough as expected for a math class, but he moved so many due dates and gave tons of extensions. Great guy!

Very good guy. His lectures are very well structured and many examples. The tests are just like the lecture problems. He gives these exam review worksheets that help a lot with the tests. Very solid choice.

He was really accesible outside of class and willing to help, but the problem is I don't think he remembers what it is like to not know the subject, and so he explains it as if we already know what's going on. the accent makes things a little difficult to understand too. He is caring when it comes to personal problems and will move a quiz if needed

Let's just start with this: there are homeworks due every Thursday at midnight. There are also weekly quizzed averaging over just a few sections of the book that you will take in either the first or last 10-15 minutes of class. NOW HERE IS THE STRUGGLE: you do well on the quizzes and the test questions look crazy, never before seen. TOTAL BS CLASS

I enjoyed his lectures and he works through a lot of examples with the class. Homework due dates vary, 1 to 2 assignments per week. I think the tests are similar to the quizzes and if you understand lecture and worksheets, you will be prepared. He is a personable professor and is always willing to answer questions in class.

He was an okay lecturer, but his test are pretty easy if you've taken calculus before. The only thing that's hard are his quizzes but he does it on purpose to help you prepare for the final. I would say just come to class and show that you care, because he really does care for his students and if you go to office hours its a big help.

Very caring teacher. Wants to see you succeed, but the tests are just so hard. Even as someone who took AP Calculus in high school, the questions asked are very difficult and unlike the questions we see in our homework. Homework is due every Thursday at midnight. Actually do the homework even if it's only a tiny percentage of your avg. It'll help.
He can be confusing, but overall I understood what he was talking about. His tests tend to be easier than some of the other calculus professors. He is always willing to help and is very nice.

I found Attarchi's lectures very difficult to follow. In retrospect, I probably would have done better skipping the class, teaching myself, and showing up to weekly quizzes. I didn't have much exposure to calculus before this class and his lectures really didn't help me grasp concepts I didn't know. He was, however, very caring and willing to help.

Great introduction to semiconductors and very in-depth coverage of MOSFETs. Video lectures are posted on his Youtube and sometimes go more in depth than he does during lecture. Homeworks are fair and pretty much exactly based off lecture slides. Super experienced guy with lots of industry knowledge that he sprinkles into lectures.

ECE3030 with Khan is awesome. Engaging class that will help you understand semiconductors and industry trends on a deeper level. Only complaint is grading takes a long time (over a month for midterm 1), but other than that I highly recommend this course.

He's a pretty funny guy. The homework is due weekly and there aren't late submissions allowed unless the TAs are feeling nice at the end of the year. The homeworks can be very difficult or super easy, no in-between. The Midterms and Finals aren't very difficult if you pay attention. All lectures are recorded and are on youtube.

Dr. Khan teaches this course at the exact level it needs to be at. He explains many of the topics very intuitively and very clearly, leaving little for the student to have to puzzle over themselves. The homeworks are straightforward and relatively short, and they are generally a grade booster. The class content is also interesting.

Dr Khan is a great teacher! He does speak slowly, but I actually like that because it gives me time to internalize the information and take notes. He also digresses by speaking about related but non-class material in the real world, such as investors, or even what the yield of a chip is, and that's always interesting! Listen and you will learn!
Professor Asif Giga Chad Khan is very knowledgable. Tests are similar to homeworks with extra credit opportunities. Lectures are available on his youtube channel. Def would take again.

I went to go talk to him about why I scored so low on the final exam, I was on the verge of a B and needed 8 points from any exam(M1,M2,Final)to get it. He showed me that he arbitrarily takes points off for things not even mentioned in the question and says it was in lecture even though he never asked for it in the question itself. Horrible grader
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Let the students focus on their actual work, tone down the class a bit.

Avoid this professor for an intro psych class. This class is doable, but I was always annoyed how much work and I had to put into this class compared to other teachers. If you want to make an A you must memorize the entire textbook and lecture powerpoints. Tests are mc, essay question, and fill in the blank whereas other classes are mc.

Rob teaches good lectures but his progress is often slow so that you need to read textbook sections that he hasn't covered but will be on the test to prepare for tests. He is willing to help and answer students' questions yet the tests, for me, are harder than I would expect for a intro-level class. You need to memorize a lot to get good grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Rob is a great professor and truly cares about his students. His lectures are always engaging and he makes some good jokes at times. It is really easy to do good in his class as long as you pay attention, do the readings, and finish the homework on time

This class is one that is very easy to succeed in so long as you keep up with the course material. A lot of the material that is covered on exams is talked about heavily during lectures, so even though attendance is not mandatory, it is a key factor to doing well in this class. Prof Ashwill is very understanding and I would take his class again.

I would recommend taking any other PSYC 1101 professor, you will not receive feedback on the quizzes so you will not learn from them. The grading system was disorganized and many parts changed. Grading takes a long time and all quizzes average very low 80s. The class consists of 7/9 quizzes, homework, an essay, and a group project.

Ashwill isn't a bad teacher by any means, I just think that his class takes a deceptively large amount of commitment. Don't go in thinking that this will just be a social science filler, because there's actually a decent amount of reading necessary to do well on his close-not quizzes. Lectures and content are very interesting though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: A really nice and understanding professor. His exams are NOT open book so be prepared to memorize a lot the day before your exam. I am pretty sure he curves the class because I definitely was not going to get an A with the way my exam grades turned out.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Overall, Rob was a good professor. I took this course as a social science credit, and I ended up really having to work for an A. The exams had averages in the mid 70's, which seemed very low for an intro psych course. However, if you are very attentive, read the textbook, and study hard for the exams, you'll be able to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lectures were meh, as this class is pretty much just straight memorization. Exams were a bit harder than I preferred for an intro psych class. Other students in the course posted their quizlets and study guides and I studied those and ended up doing fine on the exams. There is a 20 minute video presentation for the final project and a 2-page paper.

Please choose another professor. I guarantee you will 100% regret that you chose him for your INTRO psyc course. He doesn't even know what he teaches and tests are ridiculously hard. If you want to get a B or C out of an intro course, go ahead. I was taking this course as a senior, and it was even harder than my graduate-level courses.

Obscene amount of information covered on tests & closed notes. Discussions in this class don't exist because lectures always fall behind schedule. Need to know all lecture and book content. Accuracy graded HW. Few grade padding points. Too time consuming as a non major class. Not worth making space in your schedule for this section of the class...
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He was a fantastic teacher who clearly loved what he was talking about! There is a fair amount of homework and reading, but if you follow through with it, it's not too difficult to get an A.

He's a really chill guy, but his lectures are jam-packed with information. He speeds through sections so taking notes is difficult at times. Reading the textbook does help, and that's where I learned most of the information for the class. You'll need to put in the time to get a good grade in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There are online participation activities for most lectures but they are extremely easy. There is also an online assignment package you have to buy. That being said, it's a pretty easy class, I have no complaints.

Just read the textbook and keep on top of the textbook assignments and you'll get an A. Lectures are mandatory as there are participation questions but they are interesting and it's clear Prof. Ashwill enjoys what he teaches. I'm glad I took him for Psyc 1101.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Bradford is a really good health policy professor! This class was not too difficult, but I learned so much! Highly suggest for anyone looking to take a public policy elective class. Each class does have pre-readings, but it isn't too bad, as you could still do well in the class without reading.
She is genuinely so good for US Health Policy. I learned so much and the exams are not too difficult.

Dr. Bradford is awesome! I was nervous to take a stats class but she is an amazing lecturer who helped explain things so well! She's also funny and pretty young, so she's very understanding! The problem sets could be tough, but she was receptive to feedback and offered many ways to boost grades. I would definitely recommend taking a class with her!

Dr. Bradford is an amazing professor and I definitely recommend taking her as she starts teaching new classes. The class is graded by 2 tests and 4 assignments, which are hard but if you attend lectures and pay attention they are easy to get through. She is very helpful, responds to emails very quickly and is overall a fun professor to talk to.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Bradford is awesome. Her lectures are packed with material, but she does a great job in making sure students understand what is being taught. There are 6 total grades, 4 of which are problem sets, which can be a bit tricky. Overall, Dr. Bradford is an amazing professor and I would recommend her to any student.

A few problems I had with the class:
-Lectures are mandatory and long, and he always waits for 5 questions/comments from the class
-Assignments are writing heavy
-Class is more cog-sci focused than CS focused (one programming assignment was like 300 lines of if statements)
-part of your participation points are based off talking to AI TAs

Course is well-structured and the professor supports his students. TA team is slightly inconsistent and aggressive in their approach to students (Head TA accused half the class of cheating in peer reviews). His accent makes it difficult to understand what he's saying at 1.4x speed. Overall, I liked the slow introduction to AI agents in this class.

Overbearing and uninspiring. Class is bloated with busy work and he throws a fit if you don't ask a question within 5 seconds of him asking if there are any questions. By taking this class, he will run cognitive science experiments on you as a student, which is something I definitely did not want to be a part of.
Really helpful and gives great lectures. Made me get interested into the field of AI and cognition.

I have very mixed feelings. I really like this professor, but CS7637 is the worst class I have taken yet at Georgia Tech. I learned more reading about the topics on Wikipedia than I did in lecture. This professor loves busy work too, so expect a bunch of pointless writing assignments. He just isn't a computer scientist, he's a cog psych guy.
Awesome professor if you're interested in the field of AI and cognition!
Amazing lectures and awesome professor. One of the finest lecturers I'v seen so far.
Had him for intro to cognitive science.  Great teacher!  Very interesting subject too!  Reccomended for anyone who wants to learn how people think and learn.

Amazing and incredibly funny professor. He was always super helpful during office hours. 3 exams, HW, quizzes, and a final. Allowed for makeup exams. Gave practice exams that were very similar to the tests. Very good professor to take multi with.
I took him a year ago and to this day say he was the best math professor ive had at GT. Take him if you can. He's super accessible at office hours too. Can't say enough good things about him.

Took him for 4107. Has to be the best math professor I've taken at tech. I would take him over any professor. Knows his stuff like the back of his hand and legitimately cares that you understand the material. Could not recommend this guy more.

LOVE HIM!! take him if you can, he is such a good professor. he knows what hes talking about, and makes the lectures make sense. he encourages office hours like no other, and when i went he was so kind and helped. dry sense of humor also. his practice exams help a bunch. pls go to his class he deserves it. slay austin!!

Professor Christian was one of the best math professors I have had! His lectures were very engaging and he made a point to learn the names of everyone who went to office hours. He would also give a study guide before each exam that would greatly help with the exam's content. Midterms were pretty easy compared to other teachers. He was worth it!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Austin is without a doubt the best math instructor I have ever had. He does a great job at making complex topics really easy to understand. He is a very funny and approachable guy who is always willing to help you if you are struggling with the content. His tests and quizzes are very fair and similar to what he teaches. Absolute goat of a professor

Austin's always there whenever a student needs it. If you go through his notes (he posts all of them) you'll understand everything you need for his exams. His exams and homeworks are very fair and representative of what he teaches, arguably on the easier side as well. He's always understanding and reachable, If you have the chance, take his course.

Austin is definitely the best lecturer I've had at Tech and probably one of the best educators I've ever had. He does a good job simplifying complex topics while still being precise in his explanations and pretty funny. The tests are essentially the exact same as the practice tests with the numbers changed alongside generous formula sheets.

Professor Christian is an amazing lecturer. He does an excellent job of explaining difficult content and really understands his students. I have never been to office hours, but he does encourage them and seems very accessible outside of class. He also cares a lot about his students.

Professor Christian is probably the best math professor I had in my college experience, he motivates topic well, explains them in great detail, and is also hilarious. I would highly recommend going to his office hours if you just wanna talk about math in general. However the exams can be really tough!

I took Dr Christian's online class for 1552. He was great at explaining concepts and was always eager to answer questions. His office hours were super helpful too. In general, the material on tests for this class reflected the examples shared in class, so pay attention in lecture and you'll do fine.

Overall, Dr. Christian is a great professor. His lectures were slightly boring at times, but he made up for it with his humor. I would say the exams and quizzes were slightly more difficult than some of the other sections of MATH 2552, but they were fair and we were allowed to use our notes on them. The hardest part of the class was the quizzes.

Cancelled class day of the exam 2x so we didn't get a review session. Lectures are hard to understand. Doesn't care about her students at all. Doesn't compensate for cancelled lectures with videos like other teachers, send her students to a different lecture WITHOUT even asking that professor causing students to be kicked out of that lecture

Avoid at all costs. She is very confusing and not helpful in explanations. Take any other professor if possible to make your life easier. Going to studio and watching the videos posted on canvas saved me, stopped going to her lecture after about 2 weeks, tried going again, but was once again met with confusing lecturing.

The lectures are still informative but definitely on the boring side, so I would just learn the material by reading the assigned chapters, getting help at recitation, and watching any module videos beforehand and only go to her lectures for review if needed.

If you take her, you will often find yourself teaching all of the material to yourself, as she does not go in depth or teach it properly enough to do well on the exams. She does not exhibit expert knowledge on the topic and often leaves students more confused than when they entered the lecture. Linear can be difficult, but she makes it harder.

Very unorganized and the lectures are uninspired and unstructured. She does not go into depth on the important concepts and rather than clarifying them, she asks the students on their input (while most of us do not have familiarity). If you take her, you need to make extra effort to teach yourself or from the TAs (saved me). Take Barone if you can.
Lectures were very unstructured and the important topics seemed rushed while the smaller topics were taught in greater detail.

She's a nice person, but I stopped going through lectures halfway through the semester since it would be more efficient to learn the material on my own. The lectures are fast paced so I would have to spend time reviewing the material on my own anyway.

(I ACTUALLY TOOK HER FOR 1554) Prof. Wheeler does not give full length lectures and expects you to know all content prior to attending the lecture. She will only do two or three examples that last a matter of twenty minutes. If you have any possibility to take Barone do it, unless you intend to learn from the TA's.

I would highly not recommend taking this professor. She is a nice person, but her teaching style is awful. She makes concepts very difficult to understand. I quit going to her lectures halfway through the semester and instead watched another professor's online lectures. If you have her as a professor, prepare to be confused.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The midterms/quizzes for 1553 are the same for all professors, and attendance isn't mandatory. Wheeler can be difficult to relate to and hard to follow in class, so just watch Jankowski's lectures on the class page or read the textbook yourself- it's probably the only way you'll get an A in the class but isn't all that unmanageable if you enjoy it.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dear god please avoid at all costs. She is a nice lady and all but I have never struggled so much in a math class. Her lectures explain very little and you have to grind outside of class to have any hope at doing well.

Dr Wheeler cares about her students and is accessible through her office hours. She can have some difficulty explaining concepts and her lectures are very fast-paced, but she's usually happy to answer questions or repeat an explanation.

My semester with her had a rocky start to say the least. As a new professor, she had some trouble in the beginning making concepts click in many of our heads. But with time she found her stride, and I never struggled with comprehending any further topics. All in all, a good professor who just needs to get comfortable with teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Quite judgmental and the workload is heavy. Long papers and many assignments. Limited opportunities to act in front of a camera. While there is a lot to learn about acting, there is not enough time spent actually acting. It can be frustrating for those who want more hands-on experience.

I took his Music Culture and Society course online. If youre interested in the material, its a great course. I typically dont do readings for courses but Im a big fan of music and always did the readings. Even then, the quizzes were easy content wise, but difficult to complete in a short amount of time so if you dont read youre probably screwed
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is a fine professor, but the subject is a bit dull (the history of radio). He is willing to look at your assignments before you turn them in and give you feedback. As long as you do the reading, show up, and put in effort you will do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This was an acting class. As an aspiring actor, I NEVER walked out of a single class feeling good about myself as an actor or even person. He was very rude, curt, and un-constructive in his comments/grading. Does not care and will not help u achieve your goals (even if they are class-related). Very subjective grader. Different opinion  lower grade
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He was alright as a teacher. Boring subjects, but if you do what he says, you'll get an A in the class. Do the readings, don't skip, and keep up with the syllabus and you'll do fine.

He is a horrible teacher. He has no idea how to keep his students entertained, thus making the class boring. The only reason I went is because attendance was basically mandatory. He is not a fair grader. I received a 79.8 as my final grade, and he made me get a C in the class. He's rude and filthy. Save yourself, don't take any of his courses.

He really changed his teaching stype recently due to numerous past complaints. His Performance Studies class was incredibly easy, you don't need to do the readings to get an A. Just take notes on what he says and study the day before the test. Again, his teaching style has greatly changed and he grades much more leniently now. Everyone got an A.
He is horrible.  He does not grade fairly.  His expectations on reports is unreasonable.  He is truly not a good teacher.  i advise you to take anyone other than him.  He will ruin your GPA
He is the worst teacher ever.  He is a very hard, unreasonable, grader.  His class is very boring.  He is a very dirty, nasty person who's office and body is filthy.  DO NOT TAKE HIM!!!!!
Boring

One of the worst professors at tech. Does NOT care about her students. So many complaints about her from my peers about rudeness, lack of empathy, and inflexibility. Made this class way harder on us than it had to be; didn't let us review our past exams and the term paper rubric was too vague.

She delivers engaging lectures, and consistently engages the class to ask our questions about the topics in question. Her tests are very fair, and a good estimate of the amount of time spent on each concept in class and the depth needed to know information. Attendance isn't mandatory, but was recommended. Very caring and understanding professor.

She was not approachable or understanding at all. Any time I had any questions or concerns she made me feel bad about not understanding something which was really discouraging. When I asked her for help she was reluctant to help me and basically told me she was not willing to put forth the effort. Do not recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Was completely unaccommodating during the COVID-19 pandemic. I had many exams, finals, and projects to worry about in other classes as well since I was graduating that semester. She was not only inconsiderate but unnecessarily rude when discussing what she wanted for the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: he's a super sweet and chill prof!! he gets super happy solving problems so the examples are pretty easy to follow, almost follows the pp word for word. i got a 100 on the first exam by looking over the practice examples and the HW is pulled from the textbook. best prof for this class and probably one of the best ones at tech, take him if you can!!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, sets you up to succeed, and clearly lays out the course. Very organized, and will gladly help with any questions you have. One of the best professors at Tech!

Awesome professor! He cares about his students. Unlike many professors, he actually teaches his students. He is super organized and comes to class prepared and ready to teach. He explains concepts clearly. The PP notes are excellent, and he goes over sufficient examples to make sure we understand the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Ladshaw's lecture is interesting if you pay attention. He is super nice and always gives extra credits.
Prof. Ladshaw is fantastic! He's incredibly caring and really wants everyone to succeed. He's also a great teacher and explains things really well and gives clear processes to solve problems.

Easily the most kind and caring professor Ive had, always making sure to let us know what to expect on exams and grades nicely. He explains concepts well, and works out lots of practice problems that are very similar to test questions. Allows for a crib sheet on tests and gives quizzes for extra credit. Occasionally throws in some humor too
Study the PT and do the HW and you will be fine. Cares for the students. Great guy.

He teaches well but he goes too fast in class. He is willing to help in office hours. His tests and quizzes are written in a way that you are not used to seeing from the homework. Tests reflect the quizzes. Must KNOW material instead of being familiar with it. Also, USE YOUR TAs OFFICE HOURS! MATHLAB is a joke for this class, only your TA can help.
not recommeded...look for another option if possible..long tests...unsatisfactory explanation of content and extremely unapproachable

His teaching pattern is like he comes in class and does all kind of weird stuff and makes a lot of mistakes then gives a lot of hard assignment. His class is self study, if you think you will understand by reading the book, then go ahead but this professor is not recommended
This course is a great way to boost your GPA; there's not a whole lot of work and Dr. Avent-Holt makes lectures entertaining and informative.
Very good in lecture!

One of the best professors I've been lucky to have! Excellent lecturer, very clear, wants to know what the students think, and fair. You can tell he's interested in the subject matter and it's contagious. Doesn't give much homework except reading for the class (definitely do it- he likes to reference them in exams). 2 thumbs up!

Prof. Awal is always willing to help his students. He really does care about how well his students do in class. His lectures are very organized and easy to follow. There's an extra credit project he gives out near the end of the class that's fairly simple.

One of the best professors in the AE department. He has a great sense of humor and most of all, he wants you to succeed. 3531 is a tough course but taking it with him will make it worthwhile. He even got me into Blue Origin. If you have the chance to take him for anything control related, definitely do it.

Very Inspirational lecturer. I attended every office hour and did a lot of extra credit. He is the true reason why I want to become an Aerospace Engineer. He is the key connection to getting an internship

Prof. Awal is one of my favorite professors. Even though AE 1601 is meant to be an introductory class, he made it very enjoyable. He was passionate about his work and cared about all the students. Almost everyone in the class got an A as long as they did the work. God bless this man.

Respectfully, the WORST professor I've ever had in my undergraduate career. The tests were extremely poorly written, very stingy with partial credit. Often wouldn't upload the correct slides before exams. Exams are too much of the grade, the project wasn't worth enough. Please avoid at all cost… trust me any other professor will be better.

Goes by "Tuba Ketenci" on RMP too. Doesn't really know the content well enough to explain it, just reads off slides. The first exam didn't have much partial credit and two midterm exams are weighed 17.5% each so it definitely will cause major dent in your grade if you don't do well. Only take her if you've already completed a solid probstats class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are straight from the textbook and quizzes and tests are often not similar to examples from the textbook. She clearly likes teaching the course but lectures were pretty dull. The one group project was a huge boost to the grade though.
Not good. Don't take under any circumstances.

She was the worst! Her lecture videos never fully matched what we did in the book. Made us buy WielyPlus just for quizzes. She never understood the material she was teaching and was very rude on piazza. The TAs were no help either. She graded harshly on the exams. Look at "Tuba Ketenci" for other reviews on her! DO YOUR BEST TO NOT TAKE HER!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Overall, the class is relatively easy, with online lectures that are mostly useless (she just reads the slides) and lots of extra credit. However, she may be the laziest teacher I've ever had. She showed up late to every exam we had and was often aggressive when responding to student questions. Her other RateMy is under "Tuba Ketenci."

Yes she doesn't teach this class. THERE ARE NO LECTURES. Its all just online videos that have a bunch of typos. But this class is fair, the questions on the test are very similar to the textbook questions. Just watch her lecture videos, and do the book problems. If you have any questions they will respond pretty fast on piazza.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I would just like to say that though our course catalog lists ISYE 3770 as taught by "Tugba Ayer", it is not. It is actually taught by Tuba Ketenci, who at the time of writing has a 2/5 average rating on RMP. Beware.

Prof Cummings is very accommodative and kind. This class was async, it's super chill and an easy A. The weekly assignments have multiple attempts and there's tons of opportunities for extra credit. But, the only reason I didn't like the class was because I barely learnt much and there wasn't a lot of interaction with the professor.

If you're looking for an easy social science credit, I highly recommend taking this class. Tests are extremely easy and there are a lot of extra credit opportunity. Professor Cummings truly cares about her students, and is willing to make accommodations if you tell her your situation.

Literally the easiest class I have ever taken. Basically handed us the tests to study before we took them. Nearly 30 people dropped because the class SOUNDED hard on the syllabus, but it was mind-numbingly easy. The professor is nice, and the lectures are alright (you don't need to take notes), but be prepared to not learn.

I took this class Spring 2020. She was a great professor for Intro to Psychology. Her best quality is that she really makes sure that all of her students will succeed. She is lenient and understanding with your pace in this new material and with assignment milestones. Highly recommend this class for your start at Tech.

I feel like I learned nothing in this class. It is so easy that you don't have to study and you end up with an A. It is good for my grade, but looking back I learned nothing. There is a paper(15-20pg) due towards the end of the semester, but easy grades.
She was a great help to her students.

Dr. Cummings wants to see nothing but her students succeed. She was very lenient with grading and extra credit. The bulk of the grade came from group projects and a final research paper. The lectures were admittedly quite by the book, but what to expect from a Gen. Psych class. She gave very engaging activities during some lectures though.

I would definitely recommend taking Dr. Cummings for General Psychology. The first week when she goes over the syllabus it may seem like a lot of work, but do not worry. The biggest things are a few group projects which can be fun if you choose for them to be. Tests are the easiest, lectures can be a bit by the books, but Dr. Cummings really cares

Easily the best PSYC1101 professor at Tech. Lectures themselves are average, but the fact that she genuinely cares for her students really sets her apart. Tests are fair, and there are a few group projects that really aren't bad because she's very lenient with grading. She's very understanding and accommodating, as long as you communicate with her.

Professor Cummings cares so much about her students and wants to see them succeed. You can also tell she is very passionate about her subject. She is lenient with due dates too. Nothing but great things to say about her, would totally recommend.

Professor Ayhan is awesome! This class is homework and test heavy, but if you go to class you will do really well in the course! Doing the practice exams and homework will also help you do well on the exams!

Full disclosure it's been a while since I had Prof Ayhan for 3232, but the fact that I still remember her as a great teacher speaks volumes. I don't remember many of my Tech profs. My own kid is in college now which is why I'm on this site. I took 3232 in 2001 and it's crazy seeing Ayhan is still teaching this course 25 years later. She's great!

Exam heavy class which is awesome! Ayhan is incredibly sweet and quite funny, but the lectures can drag on for a while. Tests include lots of partial credit. No concepts are incredibly conceptual difficult, but it does require a heavy amount of memorization of various formulae.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great prof.  Difficult course but she makes the content understandable and goes at a reasonable pace.  Always attend lecture if you can, as she doesn't post many materials online.  Study hard for the midterms and final: even if you're not sure where to proceed, explain your thought process and she'll give you some partial credit.  Would recommend!

Lecture, homework, and exams have very similar questions. If you memorize solutions to about 5 types of problems per exam, it's easy. The practice midterms are very helpful. The final sometimes has questions from the start of the semester and sometimes the end; so, don't rely on the practice finals, review homework.

Genuinely one of the best professors I've had. Took 2027 online over the summer last year and it was such a well-structured, clearly taught class. The way she approaches concepts and introduces them should be taught to all other professors lolll. Super accessible, fair exams and HW based on lectures, very caring and helpful when I was confused.

She is one of the best professors I've had at Tech. She is very kind and genuinely cares about the success of her students. Homework could be long and tedious at times, but it helped me learn the information and prepare for the tests.

I don't understand why Dr Ayhan has a low average GPA. Her lectures are clear and her weekly homeworks cover exactly what you need on the exams. We reviewed 2027 a lot, but it was spread out throughout the semester so we learned plenty of new content even though it wasn't the hardest ISYE class.

Excellent professor, lectures were clear and examples were helpful, homeworks were weekly (but didn't take too much time) and prepared you well for the exams. Exams were very reasonable but accounted for a significant portion of the grade. Also she managed to learn the names of all the students in the class and made lectures pretty interactive.
Excellent professor who lets you know what you need to to do well. Grade consists of mainly exams, and the homework and projects. The homework and practice exams set you up well for the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Now that I'm taken ISYE 3232 with another professor, I realize that she is a gem. Yes, a GEM. Her lecture is clear, her homework is not truly easy but it will not make you lose your mind. Yes, her test could be a bit harder but you will left the class without having a grudges at the professor because you know she did an excellent job as teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I learned a lot in this class due to Professor Ayhan's lecture style. She teachers using lots of examples, ties them to real-life situations, making lectures interesting. However, she does grade a little hard on homework and tests. Outside of class, she is also friendly and willing to talk about other applications of IE. Definitely recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Course materials are pretty hard but her lectures are extremely clear and the examples help you understand the materials. Weekly homework can be challenging but she offers help in office hours and they are graded leniently. Exams are fair. No curveballs. You are tested on what you learned in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Ayhan was very knowledgeable and a good professor for 2027. She worked through a lot of examples in lecture that set you up well to complete the hw and exams were pretty similar to the examples. She understood the material well and was very fair. The workload is not bad at all with weekly homework that takes 1 hr to complete.

Eh teacher. She takes off points for the smallest things on tests even if you get the right answer she wants you to solve it her way, which doesn't really make sense. If there's a better teacher then I'd take them over her, but if not then she isn't terrible and an A is definitely doable.

I didn't know what to expect going into this class, but overall I think it was great. Dr. Ayhan is sweet, and she does a lot of examples to help you understand the material. Given that this class was online due to COVID, she tried her best to accommodate her students and get to know them! HWs and practice exams are similar to the actual exam.

Dr. Ayhan is one of the best isye profs Ive had! She made the stochastic processes class super intuitive, and I learned a lot from her lectures. Her examples in class are similar to homework problems and test questions. As long as you pay attention to her classes and understand what she teaches, youll be just fine. Really sweet and caring.

The content is challenging since it is a weed-out class and the tests are more difficult than the practice exams but doable. You basically have to go to class if you want to make above a C since she goes over lots of content and doesn't post lecture notes. No extra credit but she is very accessible if you reach out for extra help. Good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Grade is based off of 10% homework, 3 tests 20% each and a final that is 30%. She said hw and practice tests were harder than the tests themselves. Dont believe this lmao. Tests were very difficult. Hw was fine. No drops, no curves. You get what you get. Great person, I just do not prefer her as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor and very funny during class! Some of her homework problems can get hard, but she will help you if you go to office hours. She remembers all of her students names and really cares about her students.

A really caring professor. Don't be shy to attend office hours because she will assist you if you have any doubts. The tests are not very easy, but if you study and ask for help, you should do well in the class.

Ayhan was the best. The class is pretty tough, and she certainly doesn't let you take the easy way out, but she's super caring and helpful. She memorized everyone's name in our class, and she actually makes sure you're understanding her lectures. If you go to class and put the effort in, you'll learn a lot and get at least a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: While this class is tough, she does a great job of explaining the material, and if you don't understand from her lectures, she's more than willing to meet with you one-on-one. She also memorized every name in our 75-person lecture, and took time to have personal conversations with students, so she cares about you a lot. Tests are very doable.
She explains very well. However, she could be very bias with students, which make it very unfair. Tests are difficult but doable. And homework could be long and sometimes hard
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Very good lecturer, tough but does a good job of teaching the information. Fair grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Brilliant professor. One of the most caring professors, who could actually teach well, and gave really good feedback on homework. The class was structured really well, and definitely involved a lot of problem-solving.

Very helpful, clear lectures. She really wants the class to be engaged in what she's teaching  and will nag you until you participate, which is good because you really have to be paying attention in lecture. Would recommend her for any IE class. Tests and homeworks are difficult but fair

The professor's attitude/approach to teaching were disappointing. She came across as arrogant, often implying she was intellectually beyond Georgia Tech. Her teaching style lacked clarity, enthusiasm, and genuine care for students. When concerns were raised, her justifications were often dismissive.
Very slow-paced, boring lectures. Slides are poor quality and just not very organized class.

She is actually good at teaching IFF you go to office hours in person. She didn't have office hours in person until the last 3 weeks of school. She neglected the class until the last 3 weeks. P much screwed students out of getting an A in, what should be, a super easy class. When she actually put effort towards the end, she was a really good prof.

The professor kept changing the logistics during the semester as if she does not care if this puts a hurdle on the students. The course and exam procedure are not well organized and she avoids in person office hours which are the norm for any course. She also make students feel indebted which is not nice.

Right before the first exam, she changed the policy from open notes to one crib sheet. She told us OpAmps would not be on exam1. Day before exam1 released a topic list that included OpAmps. Released incorrect topic list for exam2 causing many students to fail. She just began doing in-person office hours. Online office hours are completely useless.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: When hearing criticism of her flawed teaching, Prof. Ansari directed the blame back onto the students who did not get the physics, and onto the other factors to justify herself. Most of the lectures either canceled or online as she fled to a corner to avoid the students!

I chose lecture heavy in my tags as there was no lecture light option. I felt like a bull in a china shop in this course where professor did not care about students. With a condescending attitude, if we raised any concern about the management and teaching style, she usedto divert it to physics and did not accept the criticism.

As an undergrad student, I pay high tuitions to get quality education and yet even post covid, the professor held classes online and disappeard from campus! This was so disappointing. Even the very few lectures that were not cancelled were taught just to put a check mark and a proof that she taught sth, not a fan of this method!
I did pretty well in this course but I stopped attending the lectures. The teaching style was lethargic and halfhearted.
People complaining about unclear teaching just didn't pay attention in physics. Professor Ansari teaches very clearly, gives fair tests, and a reasonable to low amount of homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I am just glad to be done with this course today. I kept learning by reading the textbook and attending lectures taught by other professors. I attended the lectures at the beginning but I relized when I was asking questions, they were not answered properly.

I am not concerned about my grade and just finished the exam for this course. I was lost during the lectures as basics of circuit theory is covered in this course. Most of the time, the professor is just copying the derivations without providing any intuitive link between the theory and physical concept! The teaching style does not resonate well.
Comparing this course with other courses I have taken, I was less enthusiastic to attend the lecture. The lectures were dry and the fundamental concepts were not thought rigorously.
She is accessible outside class even she is very busy. The content is easy to understand, but the exams are relatively tricky. Practice more problems even you think you're prepared.

She is very inexperienced but pretends the opposite. The teaching style is not motivating at all and even herself sometimes she gets lost. For this course, I wish they could assign a really good professor to teach.
Professor ansari did a good job of explaining difficult material in lecture. The in-class worksheets were very helpful.

I did find the lectures confusing and I enjoyed more going through the textbook by myself and I learned much more effective. I believe she should not teach such a fundamental course as it kills the motivations on ECE students. Every time we tried to convey the message that we were struggling she managed to justify by saying that it is a flipped!

She did not teach in a coherent manner and it was obvious that it was her first time. Several times she lost the track of materials in the class. Assignments/projects were scattered around and the course objectives ware not clearly laid out. Also, office hours were too short.

Professor Ansari thought me circuits in her first teaching semester. Tbh, she was one of my best professors ever. Very kind and caring, wants students to learn and be rewarded. Helps you understand. Extra credit opportunities. Tests are fair. LOTS of resources and preparation material (Worksheets, HW, practice). I'd definitely recommend
Amazing lecturer. Wants you to succeed and learn from the class. Extremely passionate about what he teaches. The GOAT.

Naeemi was a good professor and managed well through a very difficult subject. He understands the content very well and provides a lot of supporting material to help students gain a better understanding. He is very accommodating and supportive and wants to see students succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Naeemi is da GOAT. He prioritizes learning over making the class unnecessarily hard and his lectures are super easy to follow along with. When he asks the class a question and we can't answer, he goes back over the material like a bro. Great prof, great guy, take his class.

Rigorous professor without being unreasonably difficult. He knows the material really well and genuinely enjoys teaching students. He emphasizes class participation and his lectures are informative. Most of the grade came from biweekly quizzes and homework assignments. 10/10 would recommend.
The course was okay in terms of contents. The professor did not cover materials that appeared in the exams.

This course was broad and ranges from device limitations to system limitations. Dr Naeemi was amazing at getting concepts across to students of different backgrounds within electronics, and the transitions felt very smooth. This was the best course I took at Gatech until date- mainly cause of the teaching style. I strongly recommend this experience

Naeemi is such a bro! Seriously, I want to give him a hug he's so awesome. At Gatech a teacher of this caliber is unheard of! If you're wondering what professor to take 3040 with: STOP! This is him! Great teaching, prepares you for test, gives similar practice test online, and really cares about his students. Naeemi is a God!

Professor Naeemi did an excellent job of articulating the subject matter. He was very approachable and seemed genuinely interested in your understanding of the topics. Dr. Naeemi emphasizes classroom involvement, so make sure you're up to date before coming to class!

Best professor @ GT. Very sharp and enthusiastic about course material (akin to his area of research). Approachable and fair. Was exceptional at determining what might be the students' stumbling block(s), and addressing said topics lucidly . Would recommend without reservation or hesitation.

He's a great professor with a great sense of humor and great stories. His lectures are always engaging and up-to-date. We had a presidential election simulation, really fun and offers a lot of extra credits. Too bad he's not an official prof at GT.
Professor Azarvan is the best; super easy class and a great lecturer.

He is a very enjoyable professor and has interesting lectures if you go. I took his class at GT in the Fall of 2023. All of my exams were online and multiple choice. You also have to write 3 discussion posts (about 500 words) throughout the course on topics of your choice. This class felt like it was half a credit hour as opposed to 3. Easy A

This guy is great. Killer beard and stache should tell you everything you need to know. Funny, chill, understanding, impartial, the list goes on and on. Lectures are interesting, always relevant and intriguing topics. Participate, do the assignments, study for simple MCQ tests, and you'll do great. Multiple opportunities for extra credit. Take him.

Studying for tests and writing a few short essays is all you need to do to pass the class. Professor is very lenient and gives good lectures. Class debates and discussions are always interesting and professor is fair to both sides. Uses current events to keep things fresh and grab attention of students.

Professor Baradel is amazing! All you had to do was complete the homework (generally very quick and easy, not graded harshly at all) and show up to class (she gives like 4 free absences though). She is super sweet and accommodating with assignments, too!

Overall, this class isn't very difficult in terms of content. You typically have one or two writing assignments due every week that just ask you to reflect on what you discussed in lecture or an external website. Attendance is mandatory, but slides are uploaded to Canvas; most people do other work during lecture since there is no midterm/final.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She really cares about the topic and students and generally grades fairly leniently.
I took the online 1040 course, and it was very light. We had an average of 2 assignments per week, and max it would take if you're focused is two hours each week. Highly recommend the online course.

Took this course asynchronously. We had a lecture and a few assignments posted each week. The lectures were quite engaging and required little work. Class focused on dimensions of wellness and helped me learn a lot of strategies to improve each! Overall, great class with a great professor and TAs who are always willing to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Baradel is extremely caring and her class is super easy. Tons of busy work HW, but not graded harshly. Overall, I enjoyed the class. She takes PointSolutions attendance for small portion of your overall grade.

Amazing professor. APPH 1040 is a easy class, easy A. Just do the homeworks and you'll be fine. No tests or quiz. She's very clear and caring towards the students too. One of the nicest professors I've met.
It's a straightforward online class, about 2 to 3 assignments per week that take very little time, especially if you do an audio submission. No exams or finals either.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class, no exams or finals, but there's a good amount of busy work. Extremely kind teacher and is very enthusiastic about her topics. Would def take again
She is a very nice person, but there is just so much work for the class. Talked to friends in other sections w/ other profs and they had it way easier. Be prepared for a lot of writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you are just looking to get the required health credit done take this course! Mandatory attendance at lectures will take up about 2 hours, and then there's only like 2 hours of busy work a week. No tests, no quizzes, no long essays. Very nice professor, and lectures are interesting if you do decide to pay attention

It's a required health course but Prof. Baradel is really caring and enthusiastic about it. There are no tests or quizes and the primary assignments are just quick summaries/takeaways of the lecture slides.
mandatory attendance but its just a health class, amazing lecturer tho

Really nice person, very easy class. Attendance is mandatory but you can miss a few without any consequences (i think 4 or smthn). Don't have to pay attention in lecture most of the time, there are no tests but there are hws, not time consuming at all though. Great prof, I def recommend.

Took online async, 2-3 assignments open up per week due Monday 11:59pm. Slightly frustrating cuz some weeks I had more time and could've knocked out the next month's worth of assignment but only opens up 2 per week. Always sent out weekly announcements and plenty of reminders and always responded within the next couple hours of emailing her.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very responsive to email and made the class as easy as possible. Sent out opportunities for career opportunities, which I thought was very sweet.

Professor Baradel was very responsive via email and did not want the class to be difficult. She wanted us to learn about our mental and physical health and sends out opportunities for career and academic development. I definitely recommend taking her class!

Classes = lectures - people do work for other classes. She wants devices away during videos 3 group projects Attendance = mandatory - point solutions.  2-3 assignments/week = journal entries or worksheets, busy work & max 1 hr/week, no quizzes, self-improvement project due at end of the semester. really nice professor w/passion for teaching
Makes class as easy as she can-- and very informative! Just stay on top of submitting the homeworks. They are essentially participation credit, but there is a lot of them
Class is mostly busy work by Dr Baradel is very caring and knows about the subject. Class was mostly used as time to work on other classes and the assignments were graded very liberally.
You can find lecture slides on Canvas for assignments, in case you miss a class or didn't pay attention.

Professor Baradel's class was very easy and convenient. The assignments were sometimes a bit tenuous but graded very lightly -- mostly busy work. The attendance was mandatory, but given a few absences and also lectures were very informative and interesting.

Professor Baradel is an amazing person and you can tell she is very passionate about this subject. She is caring and understanding. However, lectures are somewhat useless and boring. No quizzes or tests, but there is a lot of busy (albeit very easy) work. The Canvas page is well organized and everything you need is on there.

Good professor and a great human being who seems friendly. No quizzes or assessments, but a LOT of busy work. Grading standards were extremely simple and easy, but this was just time-consuming and I felt it was not worth the effort. Attendance was also mandatory, would recommend an async section instead. The lectures were not that useful.

The lectures are mostly useless, but attendance is mandatory. There are three assignments every week that are annoying, but are easy. It's very hard not to get an A if you turn everything in (it's only 5% per day late too), but the class is still a headache. Not bad as an only option, but I'd try to find someone more lax or take health online.

Professor Baradel is very friendly and passionate about what she teaches and made sure that her class was not causing additional stress for students. Class grade was mostly made up by the weekly assignments which were easy and did not take long to complete. Lectures sometimes felt a little pointless but did learn some meaningful wellness concepts.

Great professor. She lectures and then you complete reflection assignments outside of class on your own. It is busy work, but I'd rather do personal reflection than quizzes and tests like other health teachers. Overall great and helpful lectures on health.

Professor Baradel does care about the course but for students looking for a chill health class this is not one of them. There are 25+ assignments throughout the semester (not hard just tedious and annoying) all outside of class and attendance is required. Do not recommend.

Professor Baradel is an enthusiastic teacher, but that's why I gave her a low rating. This is a health class, so I don't think she should ask students to shut off their laptops to watch TED Talks or assign three busy-work assignments a week. I recommend choosing a different health professor because most students take this class for an easy credit.

Professor Baradel is great! She convey's all of the information relevant to APPH 1040 in an interesting and concise way. She understands that APPH 1040 is an institute requirement, so she makes all of the assignments easy to follow! The grading in this class is amazing and she really focuses on providing the material for success in this class.

I had her for the short summer semester and she was great. She emphasizes that she tries to make this class as less stressful as possible, and it really was. The assignments are helpful and not just busy work, and she tries to involve everyone in class discussions. There are some presentations, but as an introvert, they helped me better my skills.

Prof Baradel was the perfect person to take APPH 1040 under. It was a quick and easy course, and her lectures were engaging. I would also recommend taking the summer short-semester version, as I was able to knock it out pretty easily even with an internship. Highly recommend! Just pay attention to her announcements to log things enough days.
Such a great professor! I took a lot from her class and found her to be incredibly kind and caring. Definitely recommend!
Very easy professor. She's wonderful; try to speak up in class if you can (or want to -- it's not required), because she genuinely feels interested in her students.

She's a very engaging lecturer who truly cares about the material and her students. The quizzes were straightforward if you referenced her slides, and all of the assignments were fairly simple if you followed directions. My only complaint is that attendance was ungraded until around halfway through the semester when she made it mandatory.
Dr. Baradel is very passionate. The assignments and quizzes are easy, and she provides great feedback.

This class was SO easy. All assignments are open note (a.k.a. open Canvas), so it was very easy to succeed! She is so nice, knowledgeable, and fun! I found her lectures super interesting, too. A little disorganized, but that's okay.
TAKE HER! Very helpful and responds quickly. This was a very straight-forward class and her instructions were very clear. Great experience!
Probably the best professor to take for 1060.  Do your work and participate, and you'll be fine.

An easy A if you turn everything in and attend. She's knowledgable. Rating of 3 because she changed the syllabus a few weeks into the semester (past the drop deadline) to make attendance 10% of our grade. She also posts assignments way too late, so you can't do stuff early. Disorganization and late policy changes made it hard to stay organized.

When I took APPH 1040, I only showed up to less than 25% of lectures and still got an A+. In the classes I did attend, Professor Baradel seemed to be enthusiastic and made learned health more enjoyable. I recommend her over other professors as the graded components were extremely easy to complete as long as the rubric was followed.
Easy course and kind lady. Take APPH 1040 with her, you won't regret.

Took during late short summer term. Very easy class as long as you turn in your assignments and follow very clear, straight-forward grading criteria. Easy extra credit opportunities. Very passionate lectures. Open note quizzes.

Very easy professor, took this class for short summer session 1 and everything was online async open note. I reached out once for help on an assignment and she replied very quickly and was very helpful. 4 weeks long and around 1-3 quizzes due on sundays every week. Assignments and projects were very easy, so just make sure to do everything.

As others have noted, just turn in everything on time and you'll end up with an A. If you get B's in the majority of your quizzes but turn in all of your assignments on time, you'll still probably end up with an A. Overall, a very straightforward, pleasant, and fun class.

Super light class that somehow actually helped my health during the semester -- Like it helped me identify and eliminate negative stuff and create some healthier habits. A few quizzes and small submissions, and the asynch structure helps save tons of time. She's a great professor, and this course is awesome.
Definitely take her! Each week had a video lecture with a quiz and/or assignment that were fairly short. The assignments were pretty fun and she was easily reachable and super understanding.

Def take her! I had APPH online, each week had 1/2 hr vids coupled with short quizzes or some activities. Very caring, she gave us weekly emails, very passionate about health subjects too. Do activities/personal project (pretty much participation) and take the quizzes and you'll get an A.
Easy class. Short weekly assignments and online lectures. Pretty easy A.
Great professor, and a very light asynch course you can use to supplement others. Just stay on top of weekly stuff and don't miss deadlines, which is super easy and not even really time-consuming.
don't even need to watch lectures to get an A on the hw/quizzes. super easy class just submit everything on time and you're guaranteed an A.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Pref Baradel's lectures were educational and helpful. But she did give lots of quizzes and assignments. I'd say it's still an easy A if you finish all of them on time.

I absolutely loved her. Easy class, little work, if that's what you care about, but lectures were amazing. I legitimately felt inspired by her lectures and the content she taught. She loves the content, and does a great job getting us to love it too. I could note rate any higher. Please take and show up to class, she deserves the participation.
She is very passionate about the subject material and does a great job lecturing. Although she gives a lot of assignments and quizzes, they are very easy and don't take much time. No final/midterms.

she is chill. attendance isnt mandatory. she assigns a decent bit of work but its all pretty easy. there are quizzes too but they take home and open note/internet... just do the work and you get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Brings confident and knowledgeable vibes into lectures

I took her during the Ignite 5-week term. While there is more assignments, assignments are easy to complete and quizzes are relatively straightforward. She gives a ton of extra credit and overall it was a good class with not that much effort to get a good grade. There were also no tests and everything in class was posted on canvas.

Lots of lectures and articles are posted but most of the quizzes are common sense. She cares a lot about her students and is a good resource to have at Tech. Great professor to get health credit for with minimal effort, while still learning and improving your health
Glad she doesn't take mandatory attendance and overall good professor
Easy class. Informative if you want. Some of the activities are questionably useful, but it's fine because they're short anyway. Baradel cares!

This is the sweetest lady at the school. I enjoyed her lectures because you actually learn very useful information in this class. You don't have to go to class because she posts her powerpoints but I would recommend going as much as you can just because shes such a great lady. Do your assignments and open note quizzes and you make an A

The EASIEST class at GT. You'll get an A if you spend 1-2 hours on this course weekly. You don't even need to show up to any of the classes or do the extra credit she offers (+3 point to overall grade). Everything (including lecture recordings) are online. Quizzes and assignments are easy. Just turn everything in ON-TIME and you will get an A.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER! She gives so much extra credit and has the best lectures and she knows exactly what she is discussing. Also, her class was very enjoyable and there were no midterms or final just bi-weekly quizzes that were all open note. Easiest class I have ever taken, would defiantly take her again. She really does care about her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Super easy wellness credit. If you do all of the homework assignments on time with a regular amount of effort, you should do very well in the class. The lectures are a little long sometimes, but the weekly quizzes are simple if you take the time to listen to them/read the slides. Overall, solid choice.

Such a sweet woman. she is extremely knowledgeable about health and wellness and her lectures are very educational. quizzes are pretty easy and lots of opportunities for extra credit. one annoying thing was the self- improvement video project, but it wasnt even too bad.
She's a great professor for APPH. Don't even need to show up for class, just watch out for deadlines of assignments and complete them on time and you should be good. Easy recommend!
Quizzes are online. Easy assignments
Super chill and easy class with no tests. All there is are weekly quizzes (easy since they're open note), weekly assignments, and two projects. Don't bother going to lecture.

Missing one assignment during syllabus week dropped my final grade by over six points. I reached out to Professor Baradel multiple times about this but she was completely unsympathetic. She denied my requests to schedule a meeting or office hours and replied to me with one sentence emails. Probably the worst professor I have had at this school.

Lesley Baradel is caring, enthusiastic and laid out the course in an easy-to-follow, easy-to-complete manner. The class is a much needed break from other rigorous courses and can add some great value to your life due to its abundance of relevant, practical content.

Professor Baradel is great at making sure health is easy while also interesting. This class can get annoying occasionally, but the workload is perfectly reasonable and the quizzes aren't bad at all. Don't buy the textbook, but you may need to watch some of the lectures because there are some specific questions. A great choice for APPH 1040.
A super easy class with a great professor. I highly recommend taking this course!
Incredibly easy class and such a kind professor. 10/10 recommend!! Such an easy choice!

I took her online health class this semester and it was awesome!! You basically completed everything on your own time by Sunday @11:59 PM each week. Asynchronous with occasional office hours. Lectures are pre-recorded with quizzes. She is super nice and approachable. I would definitely recommend taking this class for an easy/interesting 2 credits!!

Extremely easy A!! On Monday's she posts about an hour long recorded lecture, there's an easy quiz, and most weeks there is an assignment that'll take roughly an hour of your time. She gave students many opportunities for extra credit but to be honest, if you do what you're supposed to every week, you won't need it. No excuse to not make an A.

Baradel was relatively clear and concise when it came to video lectures. She is generous with extra credit and is flexible with students. She likes to talk about her own experiences as a dietitician which can be interesting for students.

super nice, assignments are sometimes long but easy, you get a cheat sheet for tests, cares about students and even says this class shouldn't be stressful that to let her know if you ever feel its too much
Great health professor, tests are straightforward and lectures are easy to follow along. Has guest speakers and great energy

Baradel is really nice and understands that health isn't your priority, which is nice. She is a little disorganized though, and some of the test questions can be specific. But overall, it's a pretty easy A. I put in minimal effort and ended with a 90 (thanks to extra credit)

Extra credit helps so much!! Do not take this class thinking you will never have to study because tests cover a wide range of health topics that you may have never seen before. That being said, if youre willing to put in the work, the class is an easy A and Baradel is a very funny, happy lady.

Probably the easiest APPH section. The exams are relatively simple, and come straight from ideas and verbatim text mentioned in the powerpoints. There are no gotcha statistics questions or anything esoteric asked on the tests, its straightforward memory questions. No need to attend the lecture, and there are 4 points of extra credit.

Very nice professor who cares for the students. Tests are a little tricky with some random statistics, so study powerpoints and go to class to get an A. Lots of extra credit, very little homework, with 3 one-page papers. Not the best at sending announcements, so keep your eyes on the schedule! She's technologically challenged, but not a huge deal.

Very good professor for APPH 1040 (Health) class. Her lectures are clear, and she even gives out (healthy) candy sometimes. There are tons of opportunities for extra credit. She sometimes invites guest speakers - for that, YMMV.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Her lectures are clear and simple. The class itself is fair and reasonably easy if you study a little. No reason why you shouldn't take it.

Leslie is a professor who genuinely wants you to get pumped about being healthy. She brings healthy breakfast foods to class and hands them out as rewards for answering questions correctly. She's extremely fun, energetic and enthusiastic and I really looked forward to my health lectures.

Baradel was a great professor. She's quick to respond to emails and is very helpful if you need help. Her tests are fairly easy and come straight from her power points. She gives out food during class which was very nice. She also offers extra credit. Would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Best professor ever. If you don't get an A in this class then that's 100% on you. She gives you everything you could need to succeed. I never took notes and she gives you what slides to study before the test. Just show up on the days you're told and study the slides she lists.

Professor Badura was an amazing teacher for this class. Even though the course was at 8am, she managed to keep lectures entertaining and not once did I want to skip class because of her. She is super engaging with her students and loves what she does which makes it so much easier to take the class with her overall. 10/10 would take again!
Katie really is a wonderful professor, she is a rare breed that genuinely cares about both her class and her content. I honestly wish all my professors were more like her.

I loved professor Badura! She kept lectures interesting, learned everyone's names, and brought us donuts on the second to last day. She gives you a list of what slides to study for the test, which is extremely helpful if you have a busy schedule. Would take again!

really liked her class and she's very easy to talk to. puts effort into learning everyones name and engaging people in discussion. would definitely take her class again, there's no final but each midterm (3) is 22% of the grade (tests are almost 70%). they're not difficult though, fairly easy and she posts the exact slides to study on study guides.
Great professor and enjoyable classes. Her lectures are funny and insightful. She breaks up the class into small groups towards the end to help stimulate engagement. 10/10 would take again.

GREAT PROFESSOR! She is very kind and explains concepts clearly. Gives weekly open-note quizzes and NO tests. Only one paper assignment and she gives you like 5 weeks to complete it. Hybrid format was great with her Summer 2021. 10/10 would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: INCREDIBLE! Her fall 2020 class was excellently crafted within the hybrid framework. Every time I went to class time was used efficiently to help us apply what we learned in the online parts. 1 paper, 13 open note quizzes, 13 in-person (or online) activities. Takes feedback well, listens to and respects students. I learned a ton + love her!!! 10/10

Prof Badura is really invested in your learning. She makes absolute sure you learn what she teaches by quizzing you immediately after lecture and forcing you to recall what you learned through experiential activities or learning check-ups. None of these graded activities are difficult. Pay attention to lecture and you'll get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was extremely frustrating. She talks in the most monotone voice to show us how to use CAD, and if you don't sit in the front, it's hard to see what she does on the board. The TA will try to help but then you miss more of the lecture. Be prepared to stay after class to finish studio work later in the semester and spend hours on projects.

Professor Balic does go fast through lectures, and it can be hard to keep up and follow along. For 1070 be prepared to put in more time than you expect though. Attendance is graded but if you miss studio it'll be hard to catch up anyways. Grading wasn't too harsh but was mostly done by the TA, so it might vary from semester to semester.

After this class, I am heavily considering switching majors. Not only are her lectures extremely boring and hard-to-follow, but her feedback is unhelpful and passive-aggressive. The only reason the class itself isn't difficult is because of the lenient grading--by the TA. 
This class is a 1-credit-hour-class, but be ready to spend 4+ hrs/week.

She knows her stuff, but can be hard to follow lectures sometimes. If you miss a step, you might be confused for the next 15 min. There is very minimal feedback given on assignments, but you're likely to get a good grade anyways. If you have any questions, she is more than willing to help you.
